title: Eclipse corona
description: A dark lunar disk reveals a fine white corona and a warm crescent.
useCase: A restrained celestial focal point for observatories, festivals, and launch moments.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. An astronomical illustration, not an ephemeris or physically accurate solar-atmosphere model.
look: Near-black field with a centred black lunar disc ringed by soft white radial corona streaks and a thin warm-gold crescent along its lower edge.
motion: Corona rays drift very slowly around the rim and the moon bobs slightly on a roughly 70 s sine; the alignment slider slides the moon sideways, moving the crescent.
adapt: The `FRAGMENT` shader holds everything: `rays` sets corona streak count and drift, `corona` its falloff, and `shift` the moon offset driven by `u_control`. Recolour the crescent via `vec3(1.0,.67,.32)`; keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
